logp.method_description: The examined complexes were separately added to a 6 mL of mixed solution of H2O/n-octanol (v/v=1 : 1), and sonicated in the dark for 30 min, and then centrifuged for 15 min. The absorbance of both water and oil phases was measured. The oil/water partition coefficients were calculated based on the following Equation 1: Log P = log(Ao/Aw) where Ao and Aw represent the concentrations of the complexes in octanol and H2O, respectively. Each complex was measured three times to obtain the mean value.
